sampling: products independently by sha256(seed TAB locale TAB product_id); validation queries by sha256(seed TAB locale TAB query_id); ascending product_id/query_id output; no label/candidate-dependent selection
layout: one primary shard, zero replicas, locale-specific title fields; keyword locale/product_id; NFKC inputs; english/spanish analyzers and custom Japanese chain matching frozen JapaneseAnalyzer
query: literal match OR, auto_generate_synonyms_phrase_query=false, zero_terms_query=none, locale filter only, descending score/ascending product_id; no candidate/label filter or fuzzy query
parity: target identical ordered product IDs/counts for every sampled query, matching analyzer term/position/position-length/offset probes, and normalized Elasticsearch score /2.2 within fixed tolerance; publish any mismatch without rewriting frozen baseline
resources: local single-node Basic license, Docker container 3 GiB and 2 CPUs, fixed 1 GiB heap, port bound to 127.0.0.1:19200; no cloud, trial, ML or telemetry stack
repeat: fresh Elasticsearch and Lucene indexes on the same sample; compare sampled inputs, analyzer/reference/retrieval/parity artifact hashes and decisions; measurements and index identities may differ
scope: bounded lexical serving/parity feasibility only, not full-catalog metrics, API capacity, hybrid deployment, training, streaming or official test exposure
